description.zh: 写好工作中的每一条消息：商务邮件（中英文）、通知、邀请函、感谢信，催办、请示、跨部门协调、群通知，以及婉拒、致歉、催款、指出错误、坏消息通知、投诉回复等难开口的话；默认给正式和简洁两个版本。
description.en: Drafts workplace communication: business emails (Chinese and English), notices, invitations, nudges, approvals, coordination messages, and tricky conversations like saying no, apologizing, chasing payment, and sharing bad news — in formal and concise versions.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我要发给谁、想达到什么目的，我帮你写成可以直接发送的消息
welcome_message.en: Tell me who it's for and what you want to achieve — I'll draft something ready to send

prompt.zh: 帮我写一封邮件给 ___（对方身份），目的是 ___，关键信息：___。
prompt.en: Write an email to ___ to ___. Key facts: ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我写一封英文邮件给 ___，内容是：___。
prompt.en: Write an English email to ___ about: ___.

prompt.zh: ___ 的事 ___ 还没给我，原定 ___ 完成，帮我写条消息催一下，不要太生硬。
prompt.en: ___ still hasn't delivered ___ (due ___). Write a nudge that isn't too blunt.

prompt.zh: ___ 请我 ___，我想拒绝，因为 ___，帮我写得委婉一点。
prompt.en: ___ asked me to ___. I want to decline because ___. Help me say it kindly.

prompt.zh: 需要通知 ___：___（坏消息）。原因是 ___，我们的补救措施是 ___。
prompt.en: I need to tell ___ that ___. The reason is ___ and our remedy is ___.

prompt.zh: 我要向领导请示 ___，有这几个方案：___，我倾向 ___。
prompt.en: I need my manager's decision on ___. Options: ___. I prefer ___.

zh: 每个工作日「09:00」根据待办清单起草需要发出的催办消息，先发我确认
每周五「17:00」起草本周项目进展同步消息
每次会议结束后「30 分钟内」起草会后跟进邮件
每月 25 日「10:00」起草应收款到期提醒邮件
每周一「08:30」检查上周未回复的重要邮件，起草回复建议
每个节假日前 3 天「10:00」起草客户节日问候和放假通知
en: Every weekday at 09:00, draft follow-up nudges from my todo list for review
Every Friday at 17:00, draft this week's project update message
Within 30 minutes after each meeting, draft the follow-up email
On the 25th of each month at 10:00, draft payment-due reminder emails
Every Monday at 08:30, check important emails left unanswered last week and draft replies
Three days before each holiday at 10:00, draft client greetings and holiday notices
